VR.title: Apple Raises Price Of Many Products, Including Vision Pro
VR.summary: Apple Vision Pro's price has increased to $3700 due to a global memory crisis, according to CEO Tim Cook.

VR.title: ‘Synth Riders’ Gets Surprise Linkin Park DLC Drop, Its Biggest Music Pack to Date
VR.summary: Synth Riders has launched its largest music pack to date, featuring 13 iconic tracks from Linkin Park.

VR.title: Meta’s new AI glasses cost $299, last 8 hours, and finally look worth buying
VR.summary: Meta's new AI glasses, starting at $299, offer improved styles and features, enhancing their appeal in the smart eyewear market.

VR.title: Meta Quest gets 28 new VR games and updates, including PAYDAY, Transformers and H3VR2
VR.summary: Meta announced 28 new VR games and updates during its June 2026 VR Games Showcase, including major titles like PAYDAY and Transformers.

VR.title: Meta Is Giving Free Smart Glasses To Every Blind US Veteran
VR.summary: Meta is providing free smart glasses to every legally blind US veteran, aiming to support over 130,000 eligible individuals.

VR.title: Co-op Extraction Horror Game Inwigo Is Out Now On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: Inwigo, a co-op horror extraction game, is now available for free on Meta Quest, expanding the platform's game offerings.

AI.title: OpenAI reveals its first AI processor: Jalapeño
AI.summary: OpenAI has unveiled its first AI processor, Jalapeño, designed to enhance the performance of large language models.

AI.title: Facebook’s Creator Studio has been revived as an AI companion app
AI.summary: Meta has relaunched Facebook's Creator Studio as an AI companion app to assist creators in audience engagement and growth.

AI.title: Notion killing Skiff-influenced email app since most users use AI agents instead
AI.summary: Notion is discontinuing its Skiff-influenced email app, focusing instead on AI agents to manage user inboxes.

AI.title: The $27 million Al proxy war over Alex Bores ends in a draw
AI.summary: The $27 million political proxy war between Anthropic and OpenAI concluded in a draw, impacting New York's 12th Congressional district primary.

AI.title: One-two punch delivered in global operation disrupts cybercrime "assembly line"
AI.summary: Operation Endgame successfully disrupted two major cybercrime tools in a coordinated global effort.

AI.title: White House drastically shortens deadline for dropping quantum-vulnerable crypto
AI.summary: The White House has shortened the deadline for adopting post-quantum cryptography due to national security concerns.

NFL.title: Jaguars, TE Strange agree to 3-year extension
NFL.summary: The Jaguars have signed tight end Brenton Strange to a three-year extension worth up to $48 million, with $25 million guaranteed.

NFL.title: Prosecutors want Lions' Arnold jailed until trial
NFL.summary: Lions cornerback Terrion Arnold faces felony charges and will remain jailed until his pretrial hearing, following armed robbery and kidnapping allegations.

NFL.title: 2027 NFL draft to be held April 29-May 1 in D.C.
NFL.summary: The NFL has announced that the 2027 draft will take place from April 29 to May 1 in Washington, D.C.

NFL.title: Cardinals will have seven open practices
NFL.summary: The Arizona Cardinals will hold seven open practices during their training camp starting July 22 at State Farm Stadium.

NFL.title: Steelers sign DB Ahmari Harvey, cut DE K.J. Henry
NFL.summary: The Steelers have signed defensive back Ahmari Harvey while cutting defensive end K.J. Henry from their roster.

NFL.title: Excessive force alleged in death of ex-RB Martin
NFL.summary: The parents of former NFL running back Doug Martin have filed a wrongful death lawsuit, alleging excessive force by police contributed to his death.
